questions.question: What is AI image generation?
options: Creating images from written prompts using artificial intelligence

questions.question: What is the most important factor in producing a high-quality AI-generated image?
options: The size of your computer screen
The number of images already generated

questions.question: Which of the following should be included in a strong image prompt?
Which prompt is likely to produce a better result?
options: Create a modern glass office building with blue lighting, realistic photography and a futuristic design.

questions.question: Why is brand consistency important when creating AI images?
options: It helps people recognize and trust the brand.
It makes AI generate images faster.

questions.question: Which of the following is a common business use for AI-generated images?
What should you do if the first generated image is not satisfactory?
options: Improve the prompt and generate another version.

questions.question: Why should AI-generated images be reviewed before publishing?
options: To check for quality, relevance and visual errors
There is no need to review them

questions.question: Which image style could be requested in an AI prompt?
Which statement best describes AI image generation?
options: AI is a creative assistant that helps users generate and refine visual content.
AI always produces perfect images on the first attempt.
AI can only generate cartoon images.
